_readme: Traits: desc (shown in tooltips), fx (merged into the effect engine, js/logic/fx.js), plus flags.

fx vocabulary (only these keys): maxEnergy(add) energyRec(mul) fatigue(mul: how fast working weeks wear her down, balance.json → rest.fatigue) actEnergy(mul) actEnergyBy{service:mul} actQuality{service:mul} actBan[service ids] lustBuild(mul) svcLustBuild(flag: giving services to clients build her lust) lustDrop(mul) lustMax(add) lustFloor(add) recklessAt(add) noReckless(flag) moodDrift(mul) moodDelta(mul) moodLoss(mul, only on negative mood changes) moodRest(add) trustGain(mul) skillGain(mul) statGain(mul) lewdGain(mul) jobBonus{job:mul} clientFee(mul) classBonus{class:mul} appeal(add) propRate(mul) security(add) energyBank(add) wardrobe(add) willing(add) rep(mul) promote(mul) tidy(mul) encore(add) stats{stat:add, 0-100 scale; a bonus on top of her trained stats that can exceed the cap} teach(mul: how much she passes on when teaching a class) learn(mul: how much she picks up from Sam's lessons, tutors and the classroom) wage(mul: the wage she asks) renew(add: contract renewal willingness, 0-1 scale) bondGain(mul: how fast her bonds with housemates grow) regular(mul: her chance to win a regular) tips(mul: stage and bar tips).
gen: can be rolled for generic ladies. hidden: not shown until Appraisal Lv 3. story / personal: set by the game, not rolled. excl: traits she can't have together.

earn: lets a lady DEVELOP the trait. {count:'massage', at:40} (w.counts.<key>, e.g. svc, massage, dance, bar, promo, rowdy, rescued, encore, weeksWorked, privateSam, gifts, or svcByAct.<service id>, jobWeeks.<job id>, warm = warm-ups given as a host, hosted = waiting clients entertained as a host, taught = ladies she taught, +1 per lady per week as teacher, regulars = clients who made her their regular), {stat:'popularity', at:70} (stats and skills are compared on the 0-100 scale), {trust:90}, {lewd:80}, {weeks:30} (total weeks worked; add bonds:2 to also need that many housemates at bond 30+), {job:'dancer', weeks:12}. Checked weekly; once eligible she has earnChance per week to develop it.
ngOnly: generic trait only rolled from cycle 2 (New Game+). ngPerk: offered to carried-over ladies in New Game+. Other agents will expand this catalogue: keep the schema.

Named ladies (characters.json / guests.json) may carry a personal 'unique': {name, desc, fx} (fx merged like a trait; shown on her sheet) and a 'body': {bust, height, figure} (ids from data/body.json; default medium / average / slim).

Insatiable.desc: Lust builds fast and never drops very far; her lust is spent more slowly, and even giving clients a good time works her up.

Slow to Warm.desc: Lust builds slowly and is easily satisfied; she never gets restless.

Modest.desc: Would rather keep her clothes on: they get pulled aside instead. Lewdness (and trust, with you) still brings more of them off.

Devoted.desc: Your lover. Never leaves; more willing with you; mood stays up.

Oblivious.desc: Thinks of you as the boy from next door. Far less willing with you until her story moves along.
